scope: Read-only inspection of existing engine, protocol and fixed-horizon diagnostics plus public first-party documentation. No new return backtest, no account access, no simulator/source modifications.

sources.title: Binance Futures Fee Structure & Fee Calculations
sources.supports: Commission on executed notional, maker/taker distinction, regular-user example maker 0.02% / taker 0.05%, conditional 10% BNB discount. FAQ explicitly calls numerical examples hypothetical and points to latest fee table.

sources.title: USDⓈ-M Futures Trading Fee Rate
sources.status: Live fetched page has no rate rows. Current schedule not independently confirmed from a rendered table.

sources.title: Regional official fee-table search snapshot
sources.status: Search index showed regular 0.0200% / 0.0500% and BNB 0.0180% / 0.0450%; direct open returned No records found. Snapshot is supporting evidence, not current-account or full-history verification.

sources.title: Introduction to Binance Futures Funding Rates
sources.supports: Signed transfer at applicable settlement times, position size times mark price times rate; contract intervals can change; actual settlement time has stated 15-second deviation.

sources.title: Binance Futures Liquidation Protocols
sources.supports: Mark price and maintenance margin govern liquidation; collateral mode and position exposure matter. Cannot replace with fixed equity drawdown stop.

sources.title: How to Calculate the Margin Requirement on Binance Futures Trading
sources.supports: Notional and pending orders enter margin requirement, divided by configured leverage; account mode affects formula.

sources.title: What Fees are Generated in Binance Futures Trading?
sources.supports: Commission, funding, and liquidation insurance-clearance fees are distinct.

slippage_evidence.interpretation: Fixed adverse total execution-price allowance. No extra spread deduction to avoid undisclosed double count; queue, partial fills and event-dependent impact remain unverified.

funding.formula: side * quantity * funding-minute mark open * archived settled rate
funding.coverage_validation_uses_future_neighbou: Yes, post-hoc coverage audit only, not ranking/entry.

execution.earliest: next bar open after completed signal; scenario delay is additional whole minutes
execution.stop_trigger: trade-price minute high/low, not mark-price trigger
execution.gap_execution: next raw open with adverse slippage
execution.intrabar_timestamp: minute end for ledger; true within-minute sequence unknown
execution.order_capacity: <=0.1% previous completed minute quote volume, an assumed cap not a fill guarantee

risk_and_leverage.position_margin_bookkeeping: entire entry notional reserved; not a full exchange isolated/cross margin engine

existing_diagnostics.interpretation: Signal markout diagnostic only; not a full net tradable strategy or account CAGR.

freeze_recommendation.fixed_signal_cost_gate: At signal and arrival, 2*stop_fraction >=0.006 for every scenario; deliberately fixed at original main-cost gate. It is not net expected return and not recalculated to improve stress results.
freeze_recommendation.funding: Use historical signed settlement in account replay, preserve same-minute conservative convention for comparability; separate amount affected by ambiguity.
freeze_recommendation.stress_order_size: Recompute size from each scenario cost per same risk-budget equation, as existing engine does; this is equal planned-risk comparison, not identical-quantity cost attribution.
freeze_recommendation.future_changes: A new historically valid cost/filter/latency implementation must get a new version and re-run baseline and all candidates on the same costs and data; no replacement of archived results.

blockers_for_live_or_leveraged_claims: No actual account commission schedule or historical fee-rule reconstruction.
No historical executable bid/ask depth and observed order latency/fill quality.
No historical tick, lot, market-lot and symbol-specific minimum-notional reconstruction.
No full exchange margin tiers, liquidation, clearance fees, ADL or risk-model implementation.
No ex-ante funding reserve; mark-minute approximation and settlement ordering ambiguity.
research_status: May proceed to causal feature diagnostics and explicit approximate 1x comparisons. These limitations block verified live-execution / 5x safety claims, not phase1 registration. Current paper simulator remains unchanged.
